free_tier.stated: USD 2.99 per month list, USD 1.99 during the flash weeks of 11-17 and 25-30 November 2026, for a Silicon Valley VPS with 2 GB RAM, 2 cores, 50 GB HDD, 10 TB a month and a 5 Gbps international BGP port. The mainland-optimised variant of the same shape carries 3 TB a month at the same price; the premium CN2 variant carries 1 TB a month at USD 4.99 list and USD 3.99 flash. Hong Kong is a 1 GB / 1 core / 50 GB / 3 TB row at USD 2.99 list and USD 1.99 flash. Annual rows start at USD 49.90 for 4 GB, 2 cores, 50 GB NVMe and 10 TB. The promotion runs 15 October to 30 November and returns to list price on 1 December.
